services.heroParagraphs: As a local and insured business, Ivy Cleans is proud to provide residential cleaning and janitorial services to households and workplaces throughout Minnesota. Our experienced team understands what a Minnesota home endures across a year, from six months of boots at the door to the pollen that drifts in the moment the storm windows come off. We attend to every surface, every corner, and every overlooked ledge above a doorway, and our customers receive a home that feels genuinely cared for rather than merely tidied. That care for detail is the whole of our reputation, and we guard it closely.

This is why we hold with confidence that our work in Minnesota stands up to any inspection you care to give it. Honest effort, plain communication about what we will do and when, and results you can see in daylight are the foundation of everything we undertake. A modest apartment and a sprawling walkout receive the same standard from our house cleaners. We have refined these services over many Minnesota winters and springs, and we leave nothing open to question.
Do you have a mess that needs cleaning? Are you hoping for a fresher home or workplace? Is there a cleaning project you have been putting off?
Whether it’s your home or your business, give our professional cleaning company a call today, request your quote, and put our skills to an effective test!
Reach out to Ivy Cleans today, ask us for an estimate, and let our team show you what a proper clean looks like!
services.serviceIntro: Ivy Cleans provides a full range of professional cleaning services across Minnesota and the surrounding communities, including house cleaning, recurring maid service, move-in and move-out cleans, commercial work, and steady office upkeep. Our professional house cleaners bring years of hands-on experience to every job, whatever its size, and we work with quality products and dependable equipment so the results hold up. We know how full a Minnesota week can get between work, school, and hockey, so we build our scheduling around what actually suits you.

Minnesota homes stay shut tight for a great many months, and furnaces push the same dry air through the same ducts from the first hard frost until well past Easter. That air carries fine dust to every shelf, blind, and baseboard. Our dusting service clears it out and gives your family cleaner air to breathe indoors.

Between road salt, plow sand, spring thaw mud, and the fine beach grit that rides home from the lake all summer, Minnesota floors take a beating no doormat can absorb alone. Our vacuuming service lifts that grit out of carpet fibers and hard flooring alike, leaving your rooms fresh underfoot.

Much of Minnesota draws hard water, and it leaves chalky scale on faucets, glass doors, and tile. Add long steamy showers in a sealed winter house and sticky August humidity, and bathrooms invite mildew quickly. Our bathroom cleaning removes that buildup along with germs and bacteria, giving your family a safe, healthy space.

Minnesota windows collect a season’s worth of salt haze, plow spray, and snowmelt streaks, and then spring arrives with a yellow film of pollen over all of it. Our window cleaners cut through the grime and leave the glass clear and streak-free, so daylight comes into your home the way it should.
sections.services.cards.dusting: Dusting matters more than most people realize in a Minnesota home. Ceiling fans, window casings, and the tops of kitchen cabinets gather a fine gray layer during the long stretch when the windows stay closed and the heat runs day and night. Our team works these surfaces carefully, from light fixtures down to the baseboards, so your rooms feel clean and your household breathes easier all season.
sections.services.cards.vacuuming: Vacuuming is a constant task in Minnesota, where a single winter walk to the car brings salt crystals and sand indoors, and where finished basements and carpeted stairs quietly hold onto everything tracked through them. Add shedding pets and heavy indoor months, and floors need real attention. Our professional vacuuming pulls that embedded debris out and leaves your carpets and floors genuinely clean.
sections.services.cards.bathroom: Bathroom cleaning is the chore most Minnesota households would happily hand off, and we are glad to take it. Mineral-rich water leaves crust on showerheads and spotting on glass, while winter steam with the door shut encourages mildew along grout and caulk lines. We scrub fixtures, tile, and floors thoroughly, leaving a sanitary bathroom your family can use with confidence.
sections.services.cards.window: Window cleaning restores something Minnesotans miss badly by February, which is light. Winter leaves glass clouded with salt spray, road film, and dried snowmelt, and warm months add pollen, dust, and screen residue on both sides. Our window cleaners work the panes, sills, and tracks until the streaks are gone, and the difference in how bright your rooms feel is immediate.
sections.services.cards.upholstery: Upholstery absorbs a great deal in a Minnesota house, since the couch is where a family spends the better part of a long winter. Wool sweaters, pet dander, fireplace smoke, popcorn crumbs, and damp towels from the lake all work their way into the fabric over time. Our upholstery cleaning lifts that buildup and odor from cushions and chairs, leaving your furniture fresher and far more inviting.
sections.home.landmarksParagraph: Ivy cleans serves in almost all the area of Minnesota including Minnehaha Falls, Minnehaha Regional Park, Stone Arch Bridge, Mill City Museum, Minneapolis Institute of Art, Walker Art Center, Minneapolis Sculpture Garden, Spoonbridge and Cherry, U.S. Bank Stadium, Target Field, Midtown Global Market, Nicollet Mall, Guthrie Theater, First Avenue, Foshay Tower, Bde Maka Ska, Lake Harriet, Mall of America and so on.
sections.deep.whatIs: Deep cleaning is a thorough service that reaches well past the routine upkeep of a regular visit. We work every surface, floor, carpet, and piece of furniture in your home, lifting out the dirt, dust, pet hair, and allergens an ordinary clean leaves behind in corners, along baseboards, and down in the fibers underfoot. Minnesota homes need it more than most, because we spend months sealed up tight against the cold while the furnace pushes the same air through every room, and then spring tracks in road salt, grit, and tree pollen on our boots. The result is a healthier, more comfortable home for you and your family.
